groups.title: A front door
new: A homepage with quick links to Settings, keyboard shortcuts, Arc import and feedback.
This changelog, with every build's changes in one place.

groups.title: Sound, video and reading
new: Mute background tabs, and remember sites you've muted.
Set a tab's volume and a video's playback speed.
Picture-in-picture opens when you leave a video and closes when you come back.
Take screenshots, edit a page's text, and copy and paste on sites that block it.
Find missing pages in the Internet Archive.
See information about any image.
Translate the text you've selected.
improved: Reader view lets you pick its typography and shows reading time.
Find starts with the text you've selected.
Update settings now live in About Whimsy.

groups.title: Spaces, your way
new: Drop tabs on a space's icon to move them there.
Open a link in another space from the context menu.
Pick theme colors by hex value, with transparency, menu icons and your own interface font.
improved: Each space remembers the tab you were last on.
Search for a space's emoji, or hide the space switcher.

groups.title: Tidier tabs
new: Color your folders.
A thin line shows a page loading.
Pinned tabs and Essentials show unread counts and update dots.
Group tabs by site.
improved: The New Tab button can sit at the bottom of the sidebar.

groups.title: Links and privacy
new: Copy rich links, or links to several tabs at once.
Turn off the browser's AI features in Settings.
Duplicate a tab with Cmd+Shift+D, and pin or unpin it with Cmd+D.
improved: Tracking bits are removed from links, and cookie banners are declined, by default.
Private windows are easier to tell apart.
New tabs open below the current one, inside its folder.
Choose how tab titles wrap, and dim sleeping tabs.

groups.title: Hello, Whimsy
new: Arc-style Ctrl+Tab.
App icons to choose from.
Zoom the whole interface.
See your pull requests apart from your team's.
Automatic updates.
